name: NBoc-DMT
summary: NBoc-DMT, or NB-DMT, also known as N1-tert-butoxycarbonyl-N,N-dimethyltryptamine, is a serotonergic psychedelic of the tryptamine family. It is a novel designer and recreational drug and is a synthetic modification of dimethyltryptamine (DMT) with an N′-tert-butyloxycarbonyl (NBoc) group.

pharmacology.text: NBoc-DMT, or NB-DMT, also known as N1-tert-butoxycarbonyl-N,N-dimethyltryptamine, is a serotonergic psychedelic of the tryptamine family. NB-DMT is said to be a "prodrug" of DMT that decomposes into DMT when the compound is heated (e.g., with smoking or vaping). It may also be useful as an orally active prodrug of DMT, unlike DMT itself which is inactive when taken orally.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen; Serotonin receptor agonist; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist

uses.text: It is a novel designer and recreational drug and is a synthetic modification of dimethyltryptamine (DMT) with an N′-tert-butyloxycarbonyl (NBoc) group. It may also be useful as an orally active prodrug of DMT, unlike DMT itself which is inactive when taken orally. It was first detected as a designer drug being sold online by February 2024.

summaryZh: NBoc-DMT，或稱為NB-DMT，化學名：N1-叔丁氧羰基-N,N-二甲基色胺是一種含氮有機化合物，化學式C17H24N2O2，為N,N-二甲基色胺的衍生物，可作為迷幻藥物。
summaryZhHans: NBoc-DMT，或称为NB-DMT，化学名：N1-叔丁氧羰基-N,N-二甲基色胺是一种含氮有机化合物，化学式C17H24N2O2，为N,N-二甲基色胺的衍生物，可作为迷幻药物。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the tryptamine psychedelics, can cause nausea, a faster heart rate, anxiety, confusion and frightening experiences that may lead to risky behaviour.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。它所屬的色胺類迷幻藥，可能引起噁心、心跳加快、焦慮、混亂，以及可能導致危險行為的驚恐體驗。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。它所属的色胺类迷幻药，可能引起恶心、心跳加快、焦虑、混乱，以及可能导致危险行为的惊恐体验。

fact.en: It is DMT with a tert-butoxycarbonyl cap on the indole nitrogen. This cap is a standard protecting group in organic chemistry, usually added to shield a nitrogen during a synthesis and removed afterwards.
fact.zh: 它是在 DMT 的吲哚氮原子上加了一個「叔丁氧羰基」保護基。這在有機化學中是標準的保護基，通常用於合成過程中遮蓋氮原子，之後再移除。
fact.zhHans: 它是在 DMT 的吲哚氮原子上加了一个「叔丁氧羰基」保护基。这在有机化学中是标准的保护基，通常用于合成过程中遮盖氮原子，之后再移除。
